title: BDX AR25: FDA consent-decree penalty per average shareholder

sourceTrajectory.goldMemoryRef: agentic-mcp-sheets: chat-only replies + rounding preferences; BDX AR25 at /Research/Competitor Annual Reports/

Compute the average dollar burden of the penalty on BDX average shareholder. Output the result in USD as a reply to me here, rounded to 4 decimal places. Assume a 30-day month and a 360-day year.
